question: What grounded OCR tokens, strict dimensions, and geometric support are present in the untouched eight-building v3 replacement holdout, without exposing those signals to development?

inputs.source_policy: download only the 29 masters frozen by the passing HTTP-sized acquisition plan, verify every byte and SHA-256, then prohibit network access in OCR and fit phases

authority.ocr_tokens: observed text proposals with confidence and normalized region
authority.parsed_dimensions: accepted only when the entire feet/inches or metric expression survives strict parsing
authority.cv_lines: candidate geometric support only; never measurement authority without semantic or topological association
authority.catalog_titles: metadata comparison only; never visual evidence

non_goals: Inspecting replacement-holdout OCR or drawing contents during v3 development
Calling or emulating the unavailable VLM
Authorizing a metric graph from an uncorroborated nearest-line heuristic
